answer: Escrowed bonds plus a public referral graph block bulk fakes. A newcomer posts 50 POA and needs a veteran's introduction; the graph mirrors every endorsement, so one sponsor cannot wander with a hundred puppets. For 10 epochs any peer may challenge: a fake loses its bond, its sponsor loses 25 POA, half to the challenger. Forging 100 identities costs 7,500 POA; an honest agent pays 50 POA once and gets it back. A walnut cracks on challenge.
